chapter: Black and Tan and Kansas City nightlife
title: The Black and Tan floorshow, Count Basie's band and learning to mix drinks
summary: The club had Basie's band, Jack Johnson dropping by, waitresses and bartenders, and Turner outfoxed the master bartender.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: We had a floorshow...a big floorshow...had Count Basie's band. And I never forget...Jack Johnson used to come in the nightclub all the time. He used to like to play the drums. He get up there and act a fool like he's playin' the drums. I'm talkin' about the prizefighter Jack Johnson.

So we had about fifteen...sixteen waitresses. We had a big floorshow. Everything was jumpin'. I was still a runner and tendin' bar. I get up and sing and come back down and get behind the bar and tend to my business. We had a lot of waitresses there...had three bartenders--Kingfish...I forget this other fellow's name in there... [ ] I should never forget him because he was master. He worked downtown in all the big hotels, and he knowed how to mix all the different kind o' drinks, an' he was a...a connoisseur...of mixin' drinks, an' I can't remember the man's name.

So finally he got tired of me. He couldn't watch his bowl because me and Kingfish were behind the bar so he couldn't watch us all the time, so naturally, I would learn how to mix a drink outa...one of them walk up and ask for different names of drinks. I'd watched him make 'em so I..."Come over here. I'll fix it for you." (Laughs.)

He say, "You can't mix the drink. You don't know what you doin'."

"Yes, I do. Here try me."

And they name off the different funny names o' drinks. I'd mix it all up together...had the shaker and everything. I watch him an' I learn how. I'd shake it all up and measure it.

"Try that."

So then a bunch of the waitresses like me 'cause I was the singer, too. So they come get me...get the drinks from me 'cause sometime they be so busy I forget to collect for 'em. So they love me, you know. You get him all excited he don't know what he doin'. He so happy mixin' drinks he forget 'bout collectin' for the drinks. So I took care o' all ...a lotta the waitresses, and they got 'em comin'. They come to me.
